info.title: Domovoi hub API
info.description: The hub's JSON API. Log in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session is a cookie. Send the session's `csrf_token` as `X-CSRF-Token` on every unsafe request.

post.summary:
Logs in and sets the session cookie. Five failures a minute from one address lock it
out for a while.

Creates the admin account with the one-time token from the setup link, and logs in.
Only works before the first user exists.

Answers a general question about the operator's hosts. With a connected `host` the model
may use that host's read-only tools and read skills; without one, or with an offline host,
it answers from an overview and calls no tools. It never proposes or runs actions.

400.description: The question or a turn is empty or too long

429.description: The hourly model limit is reached; Retry-After says when to come back

post.summary: Sends today's digest now.

503.description: No notifier is configured

get.summary: Committed journal rows as server-sent events.
get.description:
Frames: `ready` (`head_seq`, `resumed`, `topics`), `journal` (one row; its `id` is the journal
`seq`) and `reset` (`reason` is `pruned`, `ahead` or `lagged`: refetch what you hold). A client
that reconnects sends `Last-Event-ID` (or `after`) and receives every matching row after it.
An idle stream sends a `: keepalive` comment every 15 seconds.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description:
Comma-separated topics: `incidents`, `approvals`, `operations`, `operation:<id>`,
`hosts`, `conversations:<id>`. At most 16. Absent means `incidents,approvals,operations`.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume after this journal `seq`. The `Last-Event-ID` header wins when both are given.

400.description: An unknown topic or a malformed position

503.description: Too many open event streams

get.summary: Every host with its agent's presence, sorted by name.
Host `name` with its agent and the latest value of each digest fact from the last day.
The capability inventory of host `name`.
A host's checks: what its agent reports and what the hub overrides.

put.summary: Replaces a host's check overrides and sends them to its agent; no restart.

get.summary: A host's container runtime: what its agent found and the hub's choice.

put.summary:
Switches a host's container runtime on or off from the hub, or leaves it to the agent;
no restart. Refused when the agent's config fixes the setting or no engine was found.

post.summary:
A one-time enrollment invite for host `name`, creating the host if it is new. The
token is shown only in this response.

get.summary:
The recent log lines host `name`'s agent keeps, scrubbed again here so the page is
safe even if the agent was not. An agent too old to send them is refused with a
message telling the person to update it.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: How many lines to return, 1 to 2000. Default 200.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The least severe level to return: `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug` or `trace`.

409.description: The agent is not connected, did not answer, or is too old to send logs

get.summary:
What `host`'s machine looks like while it behaves normally; 404 before the hub has
collected one.

404.description: No such host, or no profile yet

503.description: The hub does not collect profiles

post.summary:
Collects the profile of `host` again now, and answers with it. 409 when its agent is
not connected: there is nobody to ask.

409.description: The host has no connected agent

503.description: The hub does not collect profiles

post.summary: Revokes the agent of host `name` and disconnects it.

get.summary: The skills host `name`'s agent reported.

put.summary:
Turns one of a host's skills on or off. The switch is saved in the settings table and
takes effect immediately: a disabled skill stays on the host, but the hub never runs it
and never offers it to triage.

404.description: No such host, or the agent does not report that skill

get.summary: Incidents, newest first, with optional filters.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description:
Only this group: `needs_action`, `monitor`, `pending`, `expected`, `handled` or
`resolved`. An open incident is in `monitor` or `expected` when triage said so, and
in `needs_action` otherwise; `handled` is acknowledged or muted.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only incidents whose title, check or target contains this text, ignoring case.

get.summary: Everything about one incident: report, card, timeline and actions.

post.summary: Acknowledges an incident.

Asks the triage model a follow-up question about an incident. It uses read-only tools
and never proposes actions.

429.description: The hourly model limit is reached; Retry-After says when to come back

503.description: Triage is off or the model is unavailable

post.summary:
Dismisses an incident as a known condition: closes it now with the verdict `EXPECTED`,
and when `ignore_for_minutes` is given, creates the rule that keeps the check quiet
(0 means always). The rule is stored before the incident closes, so a check firing in
the moment between the two is already silenced, and a dismiss that fails afterwards
leaves a rule that a human can see and delete on the Known conditions page. The rule
matches the incident's host, check and target; `note` is the reason, so a human can
read later what it covers. A target with `*` in it cannot be matched exactly by a rule
pattern, so dismissing such an incident with a period is refused.

400.description: Empty reason, too long, too many minutes, or a target a rule cannot match

get.summary:
The questions and answers the model still remembers for an incident, oldest first.
Answers recorded before the last clear are not in the list. An id that parses but is
not a stored incident gets 404, so a cleared conversation is never read as a
mistyped one.

503.description: Triage is off

post.summary:
Forgets the conversation: the next question will not be shown the earlier ones. Works
whether triage is on or off, and on a resolved incident too; it writes one timeline
line and publishes nothing.
Mutes an incident for a while.

Investigates an incident again as an operation, with the same caps, and reports how it
went. A report already cached for unchanged evidence is reused unless `fresh` is true.

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: Run the model again even when a cached report would fit. Default false.

503.description: Triage is not enabled, or investigations are off ([orchestration] enabled = false)

post.summary: Lifts a mute.

get.summary: Notes about one host, or global notes when no host is given.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only notes about this host, by name; absent for global notes.

post.summary: Creates a note.

Imports Markdown files as notes. Each note's title is its first `# ` heading or the
file name. Files that are not `.md`, too large, not UTF-8, empty, or titled like an
existing note in the same scope are skipped, so importing a folder twice adds nothing.

400.description: Too many files or an unreadable upload

get.summary: Full-text search over notes.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Also search this host's notes, by name.

get.summary: One note.
Operations, newest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: An operation status name, for example `running`.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only operations that act on this host (by name).

400.description: Unknown status or kind, or an incident id that does not parse

get.summary: One operation with its trace and executions.

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled

post.summary:
Cancels an operation. Pending steps and effects are cancelled; a run already dispatched
is not recalled and its result is still recorded.

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled, or the service is restarting

post.summary: Pauses an operation until a person resumes it.

409.description: Not started yet, or already finished

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled, or the service is restarting

post.summary: Resumes a paused operation, raising the named limits first.

400.description: An unknown, repeated or out-of-range limit

409.description: Not paused, or a spent limit is still spent

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled, or the service is restarting

get.summary: One step with its stored intent and output.

404.description: No such operation, or no such step in it

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled

post.summary: Answers the question an operation is waiting on.

400.description: The answer is empty or too long

409.description: Not a question, not waiting, or the operation is paused or finished

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled, or the service is restarting

post.summary:
Approves an Execution step. The body names the v2 plan hash shown on the execution; a
destructive skill, or one whose risk is not known, needs `confirm_text` equal to its name.

409.description: Expired, already decided, or the plan hash does not match

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled, or the service is restarting

post.summary: Denies an Execution step.

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled, or the service is restarting

get.summary: The timeline and graph of one operation.

503.description: Orchestration is not enabled

get.summary: Counts for the navigation: incidents, approvals and offline hosts.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Only this host, by name. Every host when absent.

get.summary: The policy at a glance: the active version, the draft and the shadow recorder.
The draft with its rules.

put.summary:
Creates the draft or replaces it. Changing a locked prohibition needs the password and the
preview hash of exactly these rules.

400.description: The rules are not valid; `issues` lists each problem

403.description: Password missing or wrong for a locked change

409.description: Stale draft revision, a draft exists, or a stale preview hash

delete.summary: Discards the draft. It changes nothing live, so it needs no password.

409.description: The draft is at another revision

post.summary:
Publishes the draft as the next version. Always needs the password; the acknowledged keys
must be exactly the blocking findings, and the preview hash that of the draft's rules.

400.description: Invalid rules, or an acknowledgement that is not a blocking finding

409.description: Stale draft, stale active version, stale preview or a missing acknowledgement

post.summary:
What a candidate rule set would do: validation, the publication review, locked changes and
a bounded simulation over recent recorded decisions. It writes nothing.

get.summary: Recorded shadow decisions, newest first.

parameters.name: differing
parameters.description: Only rows whose enforced and shadow outcomes differ.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: RFC 3339 lower bound of the recording time.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: RFC 3339 upper bound of the recording time.

400.description: A filter value does not parse

get.summary: One recorded decision with its inputs, gaps and both decisions.

404.description: No decision recorded for this step yet

post.summary:
Replays or re-evaluates recorded Execution steps under a draft, a version or inline rules.
It never writes.

200.description: The re-run decisions next to the recorded ones

400.description: A value or an inline rule does not parse

404.description: No such version, or there is no draft

get.summary: Published versions, newest first.
One published version with its rules and acknowledgements.
The current session and its CSRF token.

401.description: Not logged in; the error is `setup_required` while no account exists

get.summary: The effective configuration, secrets hidden.

patch.summary: Saves a change and restarts the hub with it.

400.description: Invalid; `issues` lists each problem with its path

403.description: Password missing or wrong for a sensitive change

409.description: Stale revision, or a field set in hub.toml or the environment

post.summary: Lists models available to the candidate provider of the requested slot.

503.description: Provider unavailable

get.summary: The JSON schema of `hub.toml`, for field help and defaults.

post.summary: Posts "Domovoi test message" with candidate Discord settings.
One GET of the candidate heartbeat URL.
One minimal call to the candidate model provider of the requested slot.

get.summary: The hub's recent log lines, oldest first, with secrets removed.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: How many lines to return, 1 to 2000. Default 200.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The least severe level to return: `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug` or `trace`.

503.description: Logs are not captured

get.summary: The last release check, if the hub has made one.

200.description: The last check and how to update

post.summary: Checks for a release now, at most once a minute.

429.description: Checked less than a minute ago

503.description: GitHub did not answer with a release

get.summary: Liveness: `ok` while the hub serves requests.

Prometheus metrics: readable by a logged-in session, or by a scraper holding the
configured bearer token. Without either, 401.

401.description: No session and no valid bearer token

get.summary: Readiness: 200 when the hub can do its job, 503 naming what it cannot.

503.description: Not ready; the body names the failing checks

AckRuleDto.description: A known condition: incidents that match it stay in the history and never notify.

check.description: The check the rule matches, for example `security.ssh_login`.

created_at.description: When the rule was created; null for rules made before this was recorded.

created_by.description: The username of the person who created the rule; null when unknown.

expires_at.description: When the rule stops applying; null means it never expires.

host.description:
The host the rule is limited to, by name; null means every host. A host missing
from the store shows as `unknown host` with its id, so the list still works.

predicates.description: Conditions, all of which must hold.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null means any target.

check.description: The check to match, for example `security.ssh_login`.

expires_at.description:
The exact time the rule stops applying, as RFC 3339, such as `2026-12-01T10:00:00Z`.
When present it is used instead of `expires_in_minutes`, so a rule can be restored
with its original expiry; an unparseable value is refused.

expires_in_minutes.description: Minutes from now until the rule stops applying; null means it never expires.

host.description: Host by name; null matches every host.

note.description: Why the condition is acceptable, 1 to 500 characters.

predicates.description: Conditions, all of which must hold; at most 10.

target_pattern.description: Target pattern with `*` allowed at the ends; null matches any target.

legacy.description:
Whether this action belongs to the old approval path, which is read-only history
next to operations: true for every action while orchestration is enabled.

plan_binding.description: Which binding family `plan_hash` belongs to: `v1` or `v2`.

plan_hash.description:
The plan hash of this action's own family: what an approval covers and what the
dispatch guard re-checks. New actions use v2; a legacy action keeps v1.

plan_hash_v1.description: The stored legacy v1 plan hash, for audit display.

reason.description: Why it was rejected or failed.

status.description: The status name, for example `proposed` or `verified`.

ActionPage.description: One page of actions, newest first.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position this snapshot was read at; apply only events with a greater `seq`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

host_id.description: The host it is about, if any.

AnswerStepRequest.description: Answering the question an operation waits on.

text.description: The answer, 1 to 2000 characters after trimming. It reaches the model as data.

confirm_text.description: For destructive skills: the skill's name typed exactly, as confirmation.

plan_hash.description: Required. The plan hash shown on the card, 64 hex characters.

confirm_text.description: Required when the execution says `confirm_required`: the skill's name typed exactly.

plan_hash.description: Required. The v2 plan hash shown on the execution, 64 hex characters.

AskResponse.description: The answer to a follow-up question.

BudgetExtensionDto.description: One limit to raise when resuming.

limit.description:
The new limit: seconds for `wall_time`, micro-units for `cost`, a count otherwise.
1 to 10000 for a count, 1 to 10000000000 otherwise.

BudgetLimitsDto.description: The limits of an operation; `null` means no limit.

cost_micros.description: Model cost in millionths of a US dollar.

BudgetUsedDto.description: What an operation has used so far.

cost_micros.description: Model cost in millionths of a US dollar.

reason.description: Why, at most 500 characters. Empty or missing records "cancelled by a person".

CapabilitiesDto.description: One host's whole inventory, plus the ids the agent reported that the hub does not know.

entries.description: One row per capability this hub knows.

unknown_contracts.description: Ids the agent reported that no contract describes. Diagnostics only.

CapabilityDto.description: One capability as this host sees it.

catalogue.description: How much of the host's implementation list the hub has read.

category.description: Coarse family used for policy specificity.

describe.description: A short owner-facing sentence about the state.

effect.description: The effect class the contract carries.

reason.description: The reason code of a refusal, when it has one.

root_agent.description: Whether the agent runs as root. A label, never a refusal.

runner_installed.description: Whether the agent reported a working isolated skill runner.

state.description: The availability state code: one of the eight.

target_kind.description: What kind of thing it acts on.

CardDto.description: The incident's chat card, as it would be posted.

badge.description:
A verdict (`ACTION_NEEDED`, `MONITOR`, `EXPECTED` or `FIXED`) or, before triage, a
severity (`info`, `warning` or `critical`).

details.description: Summary, cause and details, if triage ran.

next_step.description: The next step, if triage gave one.

CatalogueDto.description: The catalogue state of one host, as far as the hub has read it.

gap.description: The gap code when the list is not verified.

hash.description: The hash the entries were walked under, when there is one.

ChatRequest.description: A general question, the host it is about and the conversation so far.

host.description: The host to look at; absent or `null` asks about every host.

ChatTurnDto.description: One earlier turn of the chat.

CheckSettingsDto.description: One check's settings: on or off, interval, thresholds.

enabled.description: Whether the check runs; `None` keeps the agent's value.

interval_seconds.description: How often, in seconds; `None` keeps the agent's value.

oneOf.description: An integer argument bound.
A UTC time-of-day window; an earlier end wraps across midnight.
A safety fact that must be known to have a value.

expected.description: The value it must be known to have.

oneOf.description: A request-rate bound.
A permit-lifetime bound.

DigestHostDto.description: One host's part of the daily digest.

lines.description: What changed on the host, one plain sentence each.

quiet.description: True when nothing changed on the host and no incident or advisory is open for it.

DigestPreview.description: The daily digest as it would be sent now.

hosts.description:
The same digest as one entry per host, in name order, for showing each host as its
own section. `markdown` holds the same content as one document.

next_send_at.description: When the digest is next sent (RFC 3339); null when the digest is disabled.

allowed_user_ids.description: Discord user ids allowed to press buttons.

DismissRequest.description: Dismissing an incident as a known condition.

ignore_for_minutes.description:
Minutes to keep the check quiet, 1 to 525600; 0 means always; null dismisses
without creating a rule, so the check alerts again.

reason.description: Why this is not a real problem, 1 to 500 characters.

based_on.description: The version number the draft was based on.
The version number the draft was based on, when one was active.

revision.description: The draft's revision; echo it to replace or discard the draft.

EditableSettings.description: The settings as the UI edits them.

fields.description:
Where each field some layer set comes from: `ui`, `file` or `env:<VAR>`. A field
not listed uses its default. An entry for an array or a secret covers everything
under it. Fields from `file` or `env:` are locked in the UI.

issues.description: Problems with the current settings, each with its path.

last_apply.description: How the last apply went: `{ ok, at, message? }`.

revision.description: The revision a save must name.

values.description:
The merged values, shaped like `hub.toml`; every secret that has a value is
`"[set]"`, and a missing one is absent.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

error.description: A stable machine-readable code, for example `not_found`.

issues.description: For `invalid`: every problem, each with the settings path it is about.

EvidenceDto.description: One piece of evidence in a report.

ExecutionDto.description: A run of a capability that a person approves or denies.

approval_step.description: The Approval step that waits for a person.

confirm_required.description:
Whether approving needs the skill's name typed: for a destructive skill, and for one
whose risk is not known.

contract_version.description: The contract version the plan was made against.

plan_hash.description: The v2 plan hash a person approves, 64 hex characters.

reason.description: Why it was refused, not run, unavailable or failed.

risk.description:
`read`, `write` or `destructive` from the host's current skills; `null` when the
skill is not on the host now.

state.description: The derived state, for example `awaiting_approval` or `succeeded`.

step.description: The Execution step id, which is also the execution id.

FactDto.description: One digest fact about a host.

FindingDto.description: One finding of the publication review.

requires_acknowledgement.description: Whether publishing must wait for the owner to acknowledge it.

shadow.description: Whether either rule is a shadow rule.

FollowUpsDto.description: The follow-up conversation the model still remembers for an incident, oldest first.

turns.description: The remembered questions and answers; empty when there are none or after a clear.

configured.description: Whether a heartbeat URL is configured.

failing.description: Whether the heartbeat-missing advisory is open.

interval.description: How often it is pinged, if configured.

oneOf.description: What the hub overrides.
What the agent's own config sets, while it is connected.

checks.description: Every check the agent reported or the hub overrides, by key.

HostChecksSaved.description: Whether the agent got the change now.

delivered.description: True when sent to the connected agent; false when it gets them on reconnect.

available.description: Whether an engine answered on the host, so it can be switched on.

choice.description: The hub's saved choice; absent when the agent decides.

delivered.description: True when sent to the connected agent; false when it gets it on reconnect.

enabled.description: `true` or `false` switches the runtime on or off; `null` leaves it to the agent.

HostDto.description: A host and its agent's presence.

agent_enrolled.description:
Whether the host has an enrolled, not revoked agent. The hub loses sight of agents

connected.description: Whether the agent is connected now.

incompatible_since.description: When this hub first rejected the agent's protocol, as RFC 3339; absent otherwise.

open_incidents.description: Incidents not yet resolved (pending, open, acked or muted), counted up to 200.

reported_release.description: The release the agent last reported; absent when it never did.

oneOf.description: Every host.
One host.

public_url.description: The URL people open, if set.

timezone.description: The time zone for quiet hours and the digest.

trusted_proxies.description: Proxies whose forwarded headers are trusted.

skipped_files.description: Each file left out, and why.

actions.description: Actions for this incident, newest first.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position this snapshot was read at; apply only events with a greater `seq`.

operations.description: Operations about this incident, newest first.

oneOf.description: The latest triage report, if any.

oneOf.description: How the latest triage went, if it ran.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position this snapshot was read at; apply only events with a greater `seq`.

differing.description: Decisions whose enforced and shadow outcomes differ.

base_url.description: The API base URL, if set.

at.description: When the line was logged, RFC 3339.

ModelsDto.description: Models available to a candidate provider.

host_id.description: The host it is about, by id; absent for global notes.

body_markdown.description: Body in Markdown, at most 256 KiB.

host.description: The host it is about, by name; absent for a global note.

files.description: The Markdown files, one form field each. Only `.md` files are imported.

host.description: The host the notes are about, by name; absent for global notes.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position read after the command and before the operation.

as_of_seq.description: The journal position read before the page; apply only events with a greater `seq`.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last one.

OperationSummaryDto.description: One operation in a list or on the incident page.

goal.description: What it is trying to achieve.

hosts.description: The hosts it may act on.
